explanationMd: Square both sides to get 2x+3=25. Solving gives x=11, and substitution gives the nonnegative square root of 25, which is 5.

distractorRationale.c: This sets the radicand equal to five rather than twenty-five.
distractorRationale.a: This would make the radicand negative.
distractorRationale.b: This fails to subtract three before dividing by two.
